name: creative-stack
description: An adaptive Claude Code stack for creative + product work. The core plugin routes each new project and forces a taste layer so the work carries a human point of view, not an AI default. Department plugins mount only when the project needs them.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Always-on. Routes new projects, builds the project charter, and enforces the anti-slop taste layer.

plugins.name: dept-design
plugins.description: Design department: brand identity, distinctive frontend, design systems — all bound to TASTE.md and checked by a design critic. Enable per project.

plugins.name: dept-dev
plugins.description: Dev department: forces a decided stack (STACK.md), builds features bound to it, and checks the code with a dev critic. Delegates to language-specific reviewers when present. Enable per project.

plugins.name: dept-marketing
plugins.description: Marketing department: forces a decided positioning (POSITIONING.md), writes copy and campaigns bound to it, adapts it into channel-native social posts (LinkedIn, Reddit, X, Instagram) without letting the position drift, and checks every word with a marketing critic that hunts AI-slop. Delegates to marketing/SEO agents when present. Enable per project.

plugins.name: dept-content
plugins.description: Content department: forces a decided editorial strategy (CONTENT-STRATEGY.md), drafts only pieces the human selects as worth existing, and checks them with a content critic that rejects filler but not honest utility content. Enable per project.

plugins.name: dept-finance
plugins.description: Finance department: forces declared assumptions (ASSUMPTIONS.md), builds pricing, unit economics, projections and pitch-deck figures bound to them, and checks the numbers with a finance critic that hunts errors and hidden assumptions. Builds from declared inputs only; not investment advice. Enable per project.

plugins.name: dept-legal
plugins.description: Legal department: forces a declared legal context (LEGAL-CONTEXT.md), drafts and reviews common documents (NDA, ToS, privacy policy, legal notices) from templates bound to it, and checks them with a legal critic that hunts missing and risky clauses. Informational templates only; not legal advice. Enable per project.
